107: @app.post("/orders", response_model=OrderOut, status_code=201)
108: def create_order(
109:     body: OrderCreate,
110:     tenant: uuid.UUID = Depends(tenant_id),
111:     session: Session = Depends(get_session),
112: ) -> Order:
113:     quantities: dict[uuid.UUID, int] = defaultdict(int)
114:     for item in body.items:
115:         quantities[item.product_id] += item.quantity
116:     product_ids = sorted(quantities, key=str)
117:     order: Order | None = None
118:     try:
119:         products = list(
120:             session.scalars(
121:                 select(Product)
122:                   .where(Product.id.in_(product_ids), Product.tenant_id == tenant)
123:                   .order_by(Product.id)
124:                   .with_for_update()
125:               )
126:           )
127:         if len(products) != len(product_ids):
128:             raise ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Product not found")
129:         for product in products:
130:             if product.stock < quantities[product.id]:
131:                 raise ApiError(409, "INSUFFICIENT_STOCK", "Insufficient stock")
132:         order = Order(tenant_id=tenant, status="PENDING", total_amount=0)
133:         session.add(order)
134:         session.flush()
135:         total = 0
136:         for product in products:
137:             quantity = quantities[product.id]
138:             product.stock -= quantity
139:             line_amount = product.unit_price * quantity
140:             total += line_amount
141:             session.add(
142:                 OrderItem(
143:                     order_id=order.id,
144:                     product_id=product.id,
145:                     sku=product.sku,
146:                     product_name=product.name,
147:                     unit_price=product.unit_price,
148:                     quantity=quantity,
149:                     line_amount=line_amount,
150:                   )
151:               )
152:         order.total_amount = total
153:         # Insert outbox event in the same transaction
154:         event_id = uuid.uuid4()
155:         payload = json.dumps({
156:             "order_id": str(order.id),
157:             "tenant_id": str(tenant),
158:             "total_amount": order.total_amount,
159:         })
160:         outbox = OutboxEvent(
161:             event_id=event_id,
162:             event_type="order.created",
163:             aggregate_id=order.id,
164:             payload=payload,
165:         )
166:         session.add(outbox)
167:         session.commit()
168:     except ApiError:
169:         session.rollback()
170:         raise
171:     session.expire_all()
172:     return load_order(session, tenant, order.id)
